attacks.name: Electric Discharge
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Shock|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§shock§Shock| special condition.

attacks.name: Overload the Grid
steps: When creating the dice pool for this attack, this character may destroy a terrain feature of |!size| 3 or less within |!range| 3 of this character. If it does, add dice to the attack roll equal to the destroyed terrain feature's |!size|.

superPowers.name: Ride the Wires
superPowers.body: Choose a terrain feature of |!size| 2 or greater within |!range| 3 of this character. This character drops all objective tokens it is holding, then is Placed within |!range| 2 of the chosen terrain feature. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Live Wire
superPowers.body: When an enemy character ends a movement within |!range| 3 of this character, this character may use this superpower. Roll 4 dice. The enemy character suffers 1 |!damage| for each |!critical| and |!hit| rolled.

superPowers.name: Electrostatic
superPowers.body: After an attack targeting this character is resolved, it may use this superpower. If the attacking character is within |!range| 3, it suffers 1 |!damage| and gains the |§shock§Shock| special condition.
